messages.text: Our dad died and left the house in his will. My sister A wants to buy it with her husband at a "family discount". I'm not signing off on that. Our younger sister B could use some money too. Can you help us sort this out?

Not quite. Fairness means I receive a fair financial share; I won’t subsidize A’s discounted purchase, and I haven’t agreed to it. I don’t know B’s financial needs—we should ask her. My main worry is settling on a below-market deal without everyone’s agreement. No rush.
Thank you. I’d like to have some money to start a dance studio; that’s what I’m hoping for. I’m not sure yet what that means for the house or what the options are.

Thank you. My husband and I would like to buy the house, ideally at a family discount. It would give us a place to make our own, and help me feel more financially independent. I know C hasn’t agreed, so we can’t proceed without her. I’m not sure yet what price or terms would be fair.
Mostly, yes. I’d like some money to start the studio, but I can’t say yet whether that would come from a share of the estate or the house, or what amount.
Yes, that fits. I’d just add that I’m hoping for a family discount, though I don’t know what would be fair.
Okay. I still haven’t agreed to A buying the house at a discount. Please include that when you share the summary.

Mostly. I’d change “any sale should reflect its full value” to “I want a fair financial share and won’t subsidize a discount for A without freely agreeing.” I’m not saying every detail of value or shares is settled. The rest sounds right, with B’s amount and source still open.
That mostly fits. I’d only soften “a share of the estate” for me: I’m hoping for money to start the studio, but the source and amount are still open. I’m not sure what’s fair for the house.
Mostly, but I can’t confirm C’s needs or that B wants money for a dance studio—I only know B wants money. I do know C hasn’t agreed to my buying at a discount.
That fits. Go ahead and draft options; I’ll review them before agreeing to anything.
